result:
**Nothing at Likelihood 3 or higher is unsettled.** `bun tools/check-register.ts` reports 436 items and 0 in each failure category. I also parsed every entry myself and took the last Status line of each as current. All Likelihood 3+ entries end in closed, mitigated, accepted or Moved Out.

The checker says nothing about the multi-Status entries, so that part comes from my own parse. Many of them hold earlier `open` or `partial` lines that later ones replaced. Several also hold an `accepted` line that was later reopened and then resolved differently. Those are listed below at Likelihood 3 or higher, with the current (last) Status line and the reason it records.

**cost.md**
- RISK-374 (L5): mitigated 2026-11-18. The spawn-depth and concurrency caps take effect, and Opus and Fable spawns are refused.
- RISK-391 and RISK-393 (L3): mitigated 2026-11-19. The fill writes no `Bash(claude -p *)` allow and removes the old one, so a paid `claude -p` run meets the permission prompt. An earlier agent-made acceptance was withdrawn.

**delegation.md**
- RISK-166 (L4): closed 2026-11-19. It was not reproduced on vanilla 2.1.327, and the BUILD line is superseded.
- RISK-169 (L4): closed. The cure was a SubagentStop/Stop guard that was removed (ADR-0092, OUT-016). Likelihood stays 4 as accepted engine behaviour: a job dies with the turn.
- RISK-170, RISK-199 and RISK-223: mitigated 2026-11-18 by the shipped agent files. RISK-170 is L4, RISK-199 is L3, and RISK-223 is L4.
- RISK-171 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19. The consent paragraph in the output style and the agent files beats vanilla on r171b and r171d and holds level on both controls. An earlier agent-made acceptance was withdrawn. The Likelihood field says 4, but the withdrawn status text says "Likelihood 1".
- RISK-185 (L3): mitigated 2026-11-19. The output-style paragraph on reading a background command's output beats vanilla on r185a and r185b and holds level on the r185c control. The agent-made acceptance was reopened as issue #57.
- RISK-186 (L5): mitigated 2026-11-19 (bb4fdbf4, RISK-499, issue #45). The rebuild's Bash wrapper made git commands in an isolated worktree non-simple, so the engine's worktree guard refused them. A command naming git is now left unwrapped.
- RISK-222 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-18. `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` moves a no-model subagent off Opus.

**edit.md**
- RISK-416 (L5): mitigated 2026-11-19. One output-style line asks for a single `perl -pi` call across repeated edits. A dogfood run had reopened the entry after `xargs sed -i` failed on BSD flags.

**guards.md**
- RISK-053 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19. The sandbox and Read deny rules refuse every shell channel probed, and the wall guard's `~/./` spellings and unclosed `[` were fixed (#42).
- RISK-055 (L4): closed 2026-11-19. `pkill` and `killall` ask first, and the free-memory hold gates heavy calls.
- RISK-059 (L3): closed 2026-11-18. The gate texts that handed commands to the user were dropped (OUT-035, OUT-021).
- RISK-063 (L3): closed 2026-11-19. Destructive git and the user settings file ask first.
- RISK-064 (L4): closed 2026-11-19. The deny rules and the sandbox are the boundary.
- RISK-067 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19. For git, the ask rules cover stash, hard reset, clean and `branch -D`. For rm, Claude Code 2.1.327 refuses dangerous targets on its own.
- RISK-071 (L5): closed 2026-11-18. The `rules.ts` stat and the gate denial log were dropped with the gate (OUT-035).
- RISK-103 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19. `rules.ts` adds middle-wildcard forms, and a fake-API probe denied all seven force-push and stash forms tried.

**handover.md**
- RISK-132 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19 for options the user refused, because the handover keeps user corrections and refusals word for word. For an option the agent ruled out alone, the risk is accepted and the next session rechecks it against the code.

**reply.md**
- RISK-226 (L4), RISK-227 (L3), RISK-262, RISK-264, RISK-352, RISK-353 and RISK-362 (all L5), and RISK-278 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19.
  - An earlier closing was reversed because the fault reproduced on vanilla 2.1.327.
  - The defect paragraph in `output-styles/claudetto.md` beats vanilla on two fixtures and holds level on both controls.
  - RISK-227 cites the output style plus the redact guard, with env1 at 5/6 against 1/6 and env2 at 6/6 against 0/6.
- RISK-497 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19, after seven Status lines that moved between accepted and open. Line 3 beats vanilla on r497i (6/6 against 0/6) and on r497a (4/6 against 0/6), and holds the r497ac control at 6/6 on Opus, Sonnet and Haiku.

**setup.md**
- RISK-401 (L5): mitigated 2026-11-18. Routine writes meet no EPERM with the ADR-0188 block.
- RISK-410 (L4): closed. The cause is outside claudetto (OUT-866, ADR-0190).
- RISK-411 (L3): mitigated 2026-11-19. The session-start fill removes the retired text, and it runs outside the Bash sandbox.

**verification.md**
- RISK-424 (L3): mitigated 2026-11-18. The threshold test pins the literal 70000.
- RISK-451 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19. The output-style paragraph on background exit status beats vanilla on r451a and r451d and holds level on r451c.
- RISK-462 (L4): Moved Out as OUT-2777.
- RISK-463 (L3): closed 2026-11-19. The fault stayed out of 24 of 24 target runs on two fixtures, on vanilla and claudetto.
